ProgramUnit.Name: DO_RETRIEVE_PROCESSING
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE do_retrieve_processing IS
 cursor c1 is
 select distinct drive_group_id,drive_date
 from drive_groups,drives
 where drive_group_type='PIGGY' 
 and drive_groups.drive_id in (select drive_id from drives
 where drive_date between :s_from_date and :s_to_date
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_type in ('I','C')
 and status in ('HOLD','CNFRM')) 
 and drive_groups.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and drive_groups.drive_id = drives.drive_id
 and drives.chapter_id = :global.chapter_id 
 and drive_groups.drive_group_id = decode(:control_block.s_pb_id,null,drive_groups.drive_group_id,:control_block.s_pb_id)
 order by drive_date desc ;

 v_count number := 0 ;
BEGIN
 if :control_block.s_from_date is null then
 go_item('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_FROM_DATE') ;
 show_error('0080') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;
 if :control_block.s_to_date is null then
 go_item('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_TO_DATE') ;
 show_error('0080') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 end if ;

 go_block('PB_HDR') ;
 check_package_failure ;

 first_record ;
 for c1rec in c1 loop 
 :pb_hdr.pb_id := c1rec.drive_group_id ;
 :pb_hdr.pb_date := c1rec.drive_date ;
 :pb_hdr.pb_day := c1rec.drive_date;
 v_count := v_count + 1 ;
 next_record ;
 end loop ;

 if v_count = 0 then
 go_block('CONTROL_BLOCK') ;
 show_error('11276') ;
 check_package_failure ;
 else
 first_record ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_FROM_DATE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_TO_DATE','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.S_PB_ID','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.PIGGY_LOV_BUTTON','D') ;
 item_change('CONTROL_BLOCK.RETRIEVE_BUTTON','D') ;
 end if ;
END;

ProgramUnit.Name: GET_DRIVE_DETAILS
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
PROCEDURE get_drive_details (pb_id in varchar2) IS
 cursor c1 is 
 select drive_id from drive_groups
 where drive_group_type='PIGGY'
 and drive_group_id = pb_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;


 v_drive_id varchar2(10) ;
 cursor c2 is
 select to_char(pick_up_time,'HH24:MI') pickup_time from pickup_schedule
 where drive_id = v_drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;

 loop_index number := 1 ;
 sch_start_time date;
 sch_end_time date ;
 v_location_id varchar2(10) ;
 v_location_name varchar2(50) ;
 v_recruiter_id varchar2(6) ;
 v_spon_name varchar2(50) ;
 v_show number ; 
 v_draw number ; 
 v_staff number ;
 v_drive_type_code varchar2(5) ;
 v_drive_type_desc varchar2(50);
 v_recruiter_name varchar2(101) ;
 v_drive_times varchar2(11) ;
 v_pickup_time varchar2(240) ;
 v_local_time date;
 v_sch_start_time varchar2(5);
 v_sch_end_time varchar2(5);

BEGIN
 if pb_id is null then
 return ;
 end if ;

 go_block('DRIVE_DTL') ;
 clear_block ;
 go_block('PB_HDR') ;
 for c1rec in c1 loop
 v_drive_id := c1rec.drive_id ;
 /*-- Get recruiter name and drive type --*/
 begin
 select recruiter_id,drive_type,schedule_start_time,schedule_end_time,location_id
 into v_recruiter_id,v_drive_type_code,sch_start_time,sch_end_time,v_location_id
 from drives
 where drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 begin
 select first_name||' '||last_name into v_recruiter_name
 from employees
 where staff_no = v_recruiter_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 begin
 select description into v_drive_type_desc
 from valid_master_codes
 where code_type = 'DRVTY'
 and code = v_drive_type_code ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 
 /*-- Get show and draw --*/
 begin
 select sum(projected_draw),sum(projected_show)
 into v_draw,v_show
 from drive_sponsors
 where drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;

 /*-- Get sponsor name --*/
 begin
 select name into v_spon_name
 from sponsors
 where sponsor_id = (select sponsor_id from drive_sponsors
 where drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id
 and rownum = 1)
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;

 /*-- Get staff required --*/
 begin
 select nvl(number_reqd,0) into v_staff
 from drive_estimated_resources
 where drive_id = c1rec.drive_id
 and resource_code = 'STAFF'
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;

 /*-- Get location name --*/
 begin
 select location_name into v_location_name
 from locations
 where location_id = v_location_id
 and chapter_id = :global.chapter_id ;
 exception
 when no_data_found then null ;
 when others then handle_error ; check_package_failure ;
 end ;
 
 -- Converted sch start and sch end times from GMT to Local time conversion.
 
 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sch_start_time,v_local_time);
 
 v_sch_start_time := to_char(v_local_time,'HH24:MI');
 
 
 else
 v_sch_start_time := to_char(sch_start_time,'HH24:MI');
 end if;


 if :global.is_time_enabled_value ='Y' then
 
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sch_end_time,v_local_time);

 v_sch_end_time := to_char(v_local_time,'HH24:MI');
 
 else
 v_sch_end_time := to_char(sch_end_time,'HH24:MI');
 end if;
 

 --v_drive_times := to_char(sch_start_time,'HH24:MI')||'-'||to_char(sch_end_time,'HH24:MI');
 v_drive_times := v_sch_start_time ||'-'|| v_sch_end_time;
 v_pickup_time := null ;

 for c2rec in c2 loop
 if v_pickup_time is not null then
 v_pickup_time := v_pickup_time || ' ' ;
 end if ;
 v_pickup_time := v_pickup_time || c2rec.pickup_time ;
 end loop ;

 if loop_index = 1 then
 :drive_id1 := c1rec.drive_id ;
 :recruiter1 := v_recruiter_name ;
 :staff1 := v_staff ;
 :draw1 := v_draw ;
 :show1 := v_show ;
 :drive_time1 := v_drive_times ;
 :drive_type1 := v_drive_type_desc ;
 :spon_name1 := v_spon_name ;
 :pickup_time1 := v_pickup_time ;
 :location_name1 := v_location_name ;
 elsif loop_index = 2 then
 :drive_id2 := c1rec.drive_id ;
 :recruiter2 := v_recruiter_name ;
 :staff2 := v_staff ;
 :draw2 := v_draw ;
 :show2 := v_show ;
 :drive_time2 := v_drive_times ;
 :drive_type2 := v_drive_type_desc ;
 :spon_name2 := v_spon_name ;
 :pickup_time2 := v_pickup_time ;
 :location_name2 := v_location_name ;
 end if ;
 loop_index := loop_index + 1 ;
 end loop ;
END;
